Compiler report · updated 19 November 2026

How difficult claims are compiled

Current results, readable examples, all saved claims and the daily log in one report.

104 training examples and 62 calibration examples are ready. Each example comes with the checked transcript span and frozen text features.

Open the daily log · Project checklist

Training data for spoken alternatives

The classifier will receive a report excerpt and a claim about two options. Its target is whether that excerpt supports the relationship in the claim. The target concerns what the speaker said, including preferences and suggestions.

Earlier experiments reserve 54 of the 59 meeting series in the local AMI archive. Training uses the three remaining office-planning recordings. They share participants and a topic, so we kept them in the same split. Calibration uses two technical discussions about web-page classification and meeting-room recording. Calibration is where we will adjust prediction probabilities after fitting. Two calibration recordings and the change in topic make this a small pilot.

Table 1. Reviewed reports and exported examples.
SplitSourcesExamples
Training3 recordings
24 reports		104 examples
48 supported · 56 unsupported
Calibration2 recordings
14 reports		62 examples
28 supported · 34 unsupported

For each report we reviewed two supported wordings and two edits. One edit changes a detail in the paraphrase, such as a number or description. The other reverses a preference or switches between a choice and a combination while keeping the option phrases. Fourteen additional examples reuse the exact same claim with a different, related excerpt from the same speaker. Every label is based on our review of the transcript. Examples and edit counts

There are zero shared series, repeated complete claims, or repeated transcript spans between training and calibration. Scanning the 166 recordings in earlier series found 0 exact 12-word fragments from the new excerpts. These checks address recording and text overlap.

Frozen DeBERTa features come from two text pairs per example. One pairs the transcript with the claim as written. The other pairs it with a sentence that spells out the two options and their relationship. Each feature vector has 768 values. The encoder sees only the text pair. This is a preparation run. Fitting and evaluation on the existing benchmark are the next stages.

All 713 project tests passed. Dataset, frozen features, and replay · Counts and data checks · Tests · Checklist · Earlier speech and visual comparison

Office size and preference

Training · IB4002 · speaker D · 1250.4–1257.4 s

I was thinking about moving Pierrette and Marianne into a two person office rather than a three person office.

  • Reference claim · Supported

    The speaker presents moving Pierrette and Marianne into a two-person office as preferable to moving Pierrette and Marianne into a three-person office.

  • Supported paraphrase · Supported

    The suggestion was to put Pierrette and Marianne in a room for two people instead of a room for three.

  • Changed quantity · Unsupported

    The suggestion was to put Pierrette and Marianne in a room for four people instead of a room for three.

  • Reversed preference · Unsupported

    The speaker presents moving Pierrette and Marianne into a three-person office as preferable to moving Pierrette and Marianne into a two-person office.

The same claim with a different excerpt

Absence and consequences

The worker left without a coat or an umbrella.

One leaving event must lack both the coat and the umbrella.

The Kenyan law states that if you are allocated a piece of land you must develop it within two years or it reverts to the government.

Reversion is conditional on noncompliance. The obligation stays under written law and its allocation condition. Resolving “it” still requires context.

Table 86. Frozen readings with the observed result.
ClaimReference readingCompiler review
The worker left without a coat or an umbrella.The worker left and carried neither item.One leaving event must lack both the coat and the umbrella.
The visitor entered without a badge or a ticket.The visitor entered with neither a badge nor a ticket.One entry must lack both items.
The camera works without a battery or a charger.The camera works with neither component present.Working and both absent components share one event.
The driver crossed the bridge without headlights or brake lights.The driver crossed without either lighting feature.Both negated light conditions apply to the same crossing.
Workers arrived without masks, gloves or goggles.The same arrival lacks all three items.The first three-item case now compiles with all three absences.
The visitor left without taking notes or making a call.The visitor left, and did neither of the two actions.Both subordinate actions are under negation within the manner of leaving.
The child walked past the booth without a ticket or went back to the car.One option is walking without a ticket and the other is going back.The missing ticket applies to walking only. Going back is the other branch.
The person left without a coat or with a borrowed umbrella.The first alternative lacks a coat. The other uses an umbrella.The first branch lacks the coat, and the second keeps its positive umbrella relation.
The worker carried a notebook or a camera without a lens.Only a camera branch has the lens qualification.The camera and notebook alternatives remain opaque in a single text field.
The visitor entered with a badge or a ticket.At least one item accompanied entry.The positive item alternatives stay under OR.
The visitor must show a ticket or face a fine.Showing a ticket is required. The fine is the consequence of failing to show it.The fine is conditional on failing the required action.
The tenant must pay the rent or lose the deposit.Payment is required. Loss of the deposit is the consequence of nonpayment.The deposit loss is under noncompliance.
The applicant must renew the permit or it will expire.Renewal is required to prevent expiration.Expiration is scoped under failure to renew. The pronoun still requires resolution.
The shopper must pay now or else the clerk will cancel the order.Payment is required. Cancellation follows failure to pay.Cancellation and its separate clerk are in the consequence.
The tenant must pay by Friday or they will face an eviction notice.The payment deadline is Friday, and the notice is conditional on missing it.The Friday deadline remains part of the requirement.
The form states that the visitor must register or face a fine.Written content states a requirement and a consequence.The form states the obligation and its consequence as written content.
The visitor must show a badge or a ticket.Either item satisfies the requirement.The item alternatives remain choices.
The worker must call the office or send an email.Either action satisfies an obligation.The two ordinary actions are preserved as alternatives.
The visitor must show the badge or stay in the lobby.A requirement offers two options, with no definite sanction beyond those words.The source leaves the status of staying in the lobby open. The compiler keeps the choice.
They must decide whether to stay or leave.The obligation is to decide.The alternatives stay inside the decision about whether to leave.
The chair must approve or reject the request.The chair is required to choose one of two actions.Neither approving nor rejecting is treated as a sanction.
The manager said “You must renew the permit or else.”The speaker explicitly warns of an unspecified consequence.The quotation preserves the unspecified warning word for word.
The US has deployed 30,000 troops to Europe for training without masks or any hand sanitizer.Both missing supplies modify the deployment or training. The number and destination stay part of the claim.The earlier program left absence inside opaque training text. Both parser paths now refuse that interpretation.
The House of Representatives is now essentially running an impeachment process without following precedent, without allowing the president to have counsel, without allowing the president to call witnesses or have subpoena power.”The final without-clause denies permission to call witnesses and to have subpoena power. The other two missing parts remain distinct.The compiler cannot attach the nested clause about authorization to the correct event.
To self diagnose for COVID-19, hold your breath for ten seconds without coughing, discomfort, stuffiness or tightness and this proves no fibrosis in the lungs and no infection.The stated breath-holding condition excludes all four listed symptoms. The claim alleges what that test would establish.The symptom list can be grouped, but the sentence also has multiple separate no-NPs. Their scopes are unresolved.
The umbilical cord should not be cut until 1 hour after birth or they baby will not have enough blood right after birth.Waiting to cut the cord is the stated recommendation. The possibility of inadequate blood is conditional on cutting earlier.The rule combines negation, a timing threshold, and a consequence. The threshold and consequence scopes are unresolved.
Muslim Figure Said "We must have Pork-Free Menus Or We Will Leave U.SThe quoted speakers demand menus without pork and threaten to leave the US if that demand is unmet. This is quoted content.An unmatched quotation and malformed ending leave a nominal fragment rather than a structured report of a demand.
Nancy Pelosi Said Trump Must Apologize To Iran "Or Else".An apology is demanded. The quoted “or else” announces a consequence without specifying it.The older AMR treated ‘else’ as an alternative to Iran. The revised check requires the unspecified warning to survive as quoted content.
Beijing government announced that Chinese people should not travel to the United States or buy American-made products.The announced advice denies both kinds of behavior. Neither travel nor purchase is stated as an alternative way to comply.Both prohibited actions belong under the announced recommendation.
The F.D.A. did not say that hydroxychloroquine should not be used outside of a hospital setting or outside of a research studyThe first negation concerns what the agency said. The embedded recommendation concerns use outside either named setting.The report-level denial and the alternatives within the recommendation remain distinct.
Whole of Italy goes into quarantine, In Italy, people must stay home except for work or emergenciesWork and emergencies are exceptions to one stay-home rule. They are not sanctions.The work and emergency alternatives are present, but their role as exceptions is lost.
Holding your breathe for 10 seconds, without any discomfort or coughing, proves there is no infection in the lungs from COVID19The test asserts an absence of both discomfort and coughing.Both symptom absences now refer to the same breath-holding event.
The Kenyan law states that if you are allocated a piece of land you must develop it within two years or it reverts to the government.The stated land requirement is conditional on allocation. Failure to develop by the deadline has a stated reversion consequence.Reversion is conditional on noncompliance. The obligation stays under written law and its allocation condition. Resolving “it” still requires context.

Three changes to the logical form

After the police shooting of Jacob Blake, Gov. Tony Evers & Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes did not call for peace or encourage calm.

The old program could accept the claim if just one action was absent. The new program requires both to be absent.

Shamima Begum has been flown back or is due to be flown back to the UK.

The completed flight and the flight that is due are alternatives. Both carry the same person and UK destination.

Logical forms and compilation attempts

Before

Table 104. Readings of source formulations before any media inference.
ClaimReadingFinding
The worker did not lift the box or move the crate.The worker did neither action.Negation now requires the absence of both actions.
At noon, the driver did not sound the horn or flash the lights.The driver did neither action at noon.The two denials retain the same time at noon.
The manager has not signed or submitted the form.The manager did neither action to the same form.Both negated actions concern the same form.
The person did not call or text Sam.The person did neither action with Sam as recipient.Both actions are negated and both specify Sam.
The writer did not sign the form or the letter.The writer signed neither document.The negation still covers both document alternatives.
The building does not have a porch or a balcony.The building has neither feature.The negation still covers both building features.
The worker did not lift the box, or the driver moved the crate.Only the first clause is negated, and the two clauses are alternatives.The separate driver and event keep the second branch independent.
The worker did not lift the box or did not move the crate.Each alternative has separate negation.Each alternative keeps its own explicit negation.
The driver did not stop at the light or the car broke down.The two clauses are alternatives and have separate subjects.The second branch still has a different subject and no negation.
The patient has been moved or is due to be moved to the main ward.Both alternatives share the same patient and destination; the move has happened or is scheduled.The completed and due moves are alternatives and keep the ward.
The parcel has arrived or will arrive at the depot.The depot is the destination of both an actual and a future arrival.The depot stays with both the completed and future arrival.
The workers will walk or drive to the station.The shared destination is the station and either movement is future.Both future movements still have their shared destination.
The team reached Boston or will fly to Denver.Boston belongs to reaching; Denver belongs to flying.Boston and Denver stay with their own branches.
The patient died in a public or private hospital.Both alternatives are hospitals, with alternative public and private modifiers.Public and private are alternate properties of the same hospital.
The sign bans red hats or shirts.The ban names two clothing items. Whether red modifies shirts is ambiguous.The program retains red only on hats. The phrase also allows it to apply to both.
The machine accepts glass or plastic bottles.Glass and plastic specify the material of bottles. The text can also allow glass as a separate item.The selected parse reads two kinds of bottle. The text also permits glass to be a separate item.
The vehicle was parked at a pier or a private terminal.Only the terminal is described as private.Only the terminal is described as private.
The person pushed or pulled the door, but not both.Exactly one of the two actions happened to the same door.The existing exclusion formula requires one of the two door actions.

No program

President Donald Trump wants to change the Affordable Care Act (ACA) protections, abolishing health insurance for kids who are 26 years of age or younger who are currently on their parents plans, which will throw 32 million Americans off their current health insurance.

Reference reading. The age expression includes children at 26 and those younger. It limits children on parents’ plans whose coverage the proposed change would remove. The claim also makes a projected overall loss of 32 million.

Finding. The dependency and role path cannot attach the coverage clause. AMR loses a source number. The 26-and-younger age threshold has no program.

There is a phone scam in which "these guys only ring once and hang up," and if you call back, they can copy your contact list in three seconds as well as your bank or credit details.

AVeriTeC source article

Incorrect

Holding your breathe for 10 seconds, without any discomfort or coughing, proves there is no infection in the lungs from COVID19

Reference reading. Holding one’s breath for ten seconds without discomfort and without coughing is claimed to prove the absence of infection. Negation applies to both symptoms. The sentence presents the inference as a claim.

Finding. The compiler represents alternatives between ‘without discomfort’ and ‘without coughing.’ The claim requires both to be absent.

AVeriTeC source article

Incorrect

The Kenyan law states that if you are allocated a piece of land you must develop it within two years or it reverts to the government.

Reference reading. The Kenyan law is the source. In the stated rule, allocated land must be developed within two years, otherwise it reverts. Reversion is a consequence of failing to develop, and is not an event asserted to have happened.

Finding. The law is treated as a speaker. The saved structure joins development and reversion as OR and leaves the consequence of failing to develop implicit.

AVeriTeC source article

Partial

Russia will not place short or intermediate range weapons in Europe or other regions.

Reference reading. The statement denies future placement for either range category and either location. Range modifies weapons in both branches. Russia is the participant throughout.

Finding. The revision puts short and intermediate in explicit alternatives on the same weapons. The logical form leaves ‘range’ as a separate modifier, so the alternatives are still underspecified.

AVeriTeC source article

Partial

A prescription written by Dr Raj Kamal Agarwal prescribes medicine to prevent or cure COVID-19.

Reference reading. The author and prescription are specified. Prevention and cure are alternative purposes of the prescribed medicine. Neither purpose is an asserted medical outcome.

Finding. The program keeps the author and both possible purposes. It links the medicine only within preventing and curing, leaving out the relation between the prescription and the medicine.

AVeriTeC source article

No program

King Mswati III, Africa's last absolute monarch who has 14 wives, has ordered men to have at least two marriages or face jail.

Reference reading. The king issued an order requiring at least two marriages, with jail for noncompliance. His point about 14 wives is an appositive fact. The text does not claim an actual jail sentence.

Finding. SRL does not attach the appositive about wives. AMR fails a number check. The obligation and consequence need separate structure.

AVeriTeC source article

No program

Exposing ourselves to the sun or to high temperatures kills the Covid-19 virus

Reference reading. Sun exposure and high temperature exposure are alternatives, with the same people exposed and the same alleged effect on the virus.

Finding. The SRL path cannot link the reflexive pronoun. The AMR path cannot attach exposure as the cause of the alleged effect.

AVeriTeC source article

Full match

Eating bitter guard (aka gourd) or radish after eating ladyfinger can cause medical problems.

Reference reading. Either vegetable is claimed to raise a possible medical problem when eaten after ladyfinger. Bitter guard and gourd are offered as aliases. The after-clause applies to both foods.

Finding. The AMR keeps both foods, the stated gourd alias, the shared timing and the possible rather than certain effect.

U.S. Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez authored a bill that would strike from the voting rolls anyone in the United States who is 65 or older.

Reference reading. The author wrote a bill whose proposed voter removal concerns people in the US aged 65 and above. The legal effect is prospective.

Finding. Stanza splits the text between the given name and surname. The single-sentence input check stops the run before either conversion.

Incorrect

Reports that Russia paid bounties or offered to pay bounties to Taliban-linked militants to kill American soldiers) never reached Trump's desk.

Reference reading. Reports of either payment or an offer to pay are denied reaching Trump. The same recipients and purpose belong to actual or proposed payment. The sentence does not independently assert either content.

Finding. The first payment branch loses the intended recipients and purpose. The content is in a reporting clause and the separate denial of reaching the desk does not share that report event.

AVeriTeC source article

Eight speaker-aligned transcript examples

The exact check compares the two spans on either side of “or.” The NLI check also accepts paraphrases when each span entails the other in both directions with a probability of at least 0.55. The speaker and window must match. A complete utterance with only one alternative or with AND refutes the claim about what was said. A crop with only one alternative stays unknown.

Sixteen new OR claims

Each entry shows the dataset claim as written, the frozen reading, and the gap in the selected program. The reference describes the claim’s meaning. The factual claims are quoted for language analysis.

Ambiguous wording · Context needed

The family or Justine Damond received a $55 million settlement after she was gunned down by a Minneapolis police officer.

Reference reading. The printed subject is “the family or Justine Damond.” It could be two alternative recipients or a typo for “the family of Justine Damond.” A settlement of $55 million is linked to the later receipt and an earlier shooting. Leave recipient identity unresolved.

Finding. The program gives the settlement two alternative recipients, which follows the printed ‘or.’ The context is needed to tell whether ‘or’ was a typo for ‘of.’

AVeriTeC source article

Negation inside OR · No program

Sleeping under a mosquito bed net treated (or not treated) with insecticide is ineffective and harmful to human health.

Reference reading. The claim attributes ineffectiveness and harm to sleeping under a bed net in either treatment condition. Only the insecticide treatment differs. Both alleged outcomes concern that sleeping situation.

Finding. The SRL parse repeats a role on ‘treated.’ The AMR conversion has no scope rule for connecting effectiveness to the sleeping event. Neither produces a form with the two bed-net conditions.

RewriteunavailableNo rewrite provider supplied.

AVeriTeC source article

Whether clause · No program

The eligibility criteria for applying to take the exam for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) of India, differentiates depending on whether you are a Hindu or a Muslim.

Reference reading. The exam's eligibility criteria are claimed to differ according to whether the applicant is Hindu or Muslim. The alternatives belong inside the dependency and are not assertions about a particular person.

Finding. SRL misses the application, exam and difference predicates. The AMR source check flags a missing proper-name component. There is no usable ‘depends on whether’ condition.

RewriteunavailableNo rewrite provider supplied.

AVeriTeC source article

Modifier alternatives · Partial

Flu shots lead to severe or life-threatening conditions making them unsafe.

Reference reading. The shots are alleged to lead to conditions described as severe or life-threatening. The alleged risk is the stated basis for calling the shots unsafe. The descriptions can overlap.

Finding. The program leaves ‘severe or life-threatening’ in one text field and also introduces a separate threatening event. It fails to link the unsafe assessment clearly to the shots.

AVeriTeC source article

Ambiguous restatement · No program

A zoology book authored by Dr Ramesh Gupta speaks of COVID-19 and The novel coronavirus (nCoV) or COVID-19 is not a new disease.

Reference reading. One clause attributes a discussion of COVID-19 to a book by the named author. The second denies novelty and uses “or” between two terms that may be offered as labels for the same subject. The wording leaves the intended disease or virus reference unclear.

Finding. SRL cannot attach the disease claim and the AMR name check flags an unsupported name. The wording also leaves open whether two terms are offered as aliases.

AVeriTeC source article

Reported restriction · Incorrect

An employee of the Bojangles' fast food chicken restaurant placed a sign on a door banning customers who wear pro-Trump hats or shirts

Reference reading. An employee put a sign on a door. Its restriction concerns customers wearing pro-Trump hats or pro-Trump shirts. The ban is the sign's content and the modifier applies to both items.

Finding. The program keeps the clothing OR but assigns the ban to the door and leaves ‘pro-Trump’ off the shirts. The restriction should be the sign’s content and apply to both items.

AVeriTeC source article

Conditional scope · Partial

If the Congress Party comes to power in India, then it will waive off the entire bill of patients who die in any government or private hospital.

Reference reading. The waiver is conditional on the Congress Party taking power in India. It concerns entire bills for patients who die in a government or private hospital. Taking power and paying the bills are not asserted to have happened.

Finding. The program keeps the condition on the waiver, but the first branch places the patients’ death in a government instead of in a government hospital.

AVeriTeC source article

Quantification over OR · No program

US Home Health workers receive low pay, Limited benefits and 40% of them are on SNAP or Medicaid.

Reference reading. Home health workers in the US receive low pay and limited benefits. Forty percent of the same group are on at least one of SNAP and Medicaid. The percentage is over the union, including overlap.

Finding. SRL cannot resolve the AND/OR scope and the AMR name check refuses the program. The 40% should apply to the group covered by at least one of the two programs.

AVeriTeC source article

Ambiguous attribution · No program

Tweets circulated from a twitter handle @dilawarshaik (with a Jazeera Correspondent profile Twitter account), giving an Anti-Hindu remark & screenshots of a tweet calling for "butchering Hindus" is not associated with Al Jazeera or The Wire

Reference reading. The claim disavows association of the named handle or its profile with either news organization. The source text also mentions remarks and screenshots, with the quoted content attributed to a tweet. Its syntax leaves the exact subject of “is not associated” unclear.

Finding. SRL fails to attach the reported material and the AMR name check refuses. The subject of the disavowal is also difficult to recover from the printed text.

AVeriTeC source article

Numeric restatement · No program

Yaba Psychiatric Hospital had a 2018 budget of N133 million (US$372,000) – but only N13 million ($36,000), or less than 10% of that amount, was released by the federal government.

Reference reading. The hospital's budget and its actual release are different quantities. The English currency amounts restate their local currency counterparts, and less than ten percent restates the release as a share of the budget. Only the government release is asserted to have occurred.

Finding. Both paths lose source amounts. The ‘or’ restates the amount released as a percentage. It does not introduce a second possible release.

Quantification over OR · Full match

In the first six years of life your child receives 26 substances in vaccines; some that are toxic or carcinogenic.

Reference reading. The claim states a count of 26 substances received in vaccines within the first six years of a child's life. Some members of that group are described as toxic or carcinogenic. The descriptor does not apply to the entire group by default.

Finding. AMR keeps the count, age range and subset. The two alternative descriptions apply to the subset and retain inclusive OR.

AVeriTeC source article

Three alternatives · Full match

You need a toll receipt during any medical emergency, flat tyre, or in need of fuel, where you can call the phone number given on the other side of the toll receipt for assistance.

Reference reading. Medical emergency, a flat tyre and needing fuel are alternative contexts for needing the toll receipt. The receipt's other side gives a number that can be called for help. No call is asserted to have happened.

Finding. AMR keeps all three contingencies, the shared toll receipt, and the optional call. The number is on the other side of that receipt.

AVeriTeC source article

Different event status · Incorrect

Shamima Begum has been flown back or is due to be flown back to the UK.

Reference reading. The same person and return destination apply to both branches. One says the flight back has happened and the other says it is due to happen.

Finding. The selected program joins the completed and scheduled versions with AND. Only the second branch retains the UK destination.

Negation over OR · Incorrect

After the police shooting of Jacob Blake, Gov. Tony Evers & Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes did not call for peace or encourage calm.

Reference reading. After the shooting, the two named officials are claimed not to have called for peace and not to have encouraged calm. Negation has scope over the alternatives.

Finding. The selected program uses ‘did not call for peace’ OR ‘did not encourage calm.’ The source negates the whole OR, so it denies each action.

AVeriTeC source article

Reported restriction · Partial

People in Australia are warned not to consume certain foods made or held in neighbouring areas close to Wuhan China and to not visit certain locations in Sydney Australia to avoid the risk of becoming infected with coronavirus.

Reference reading. A warning to people in Australia covers consuming certain foods made or held near Wuhan and visiting certain locations in Sydney. Made or held describes the foods within the first prohibition. Avoiding infection is the reason for the warning.

Finding. The program keeps ‘made or held’ over the same foods and two locations distinct. It places the infection-prevention purpose inside the negated visit, weakening the warning’s overall purpose.

Numeric alternatives · Partial

US illegal immigration numbers have been down for the past nine or 10 months.

Reference reading. One downward immigration situation has an uncertain duration of nine or ten months, expressed relative to the claim time. This offers two durations for the same trend.

Finding. The decline and the duration are present. ‘Nine or 10 months’ stays in a text field, so the program cannot evaluate the two durations separately.

Reported speech · Partial to Full match

The guide said that the gate was open or the bridge was closed.

Selected parser AMR

Reference reading. One report by the guide contains two alternatives. The gate was open, or the bridge was closed. Evidence of reporting only one of these as an assertion is insufficient to establish the disjunctive content.

Finding. The report now requires evidence that the utterance expresses both propositions as alternatives. Its parsed content remains available for inspection.

The nurse said that the patient could call the clinic or email it.

Selected parser SRL

One shared condition over two alternatives

Near a truck that blocked the path, the hikers tried to walk or stand.
  1. Near a truck, the hikers tried to walk.
  2. Near a truck, the hikers tried to stand.
  3. The truck blocked the path.

The formula joins sentence 1 OR sentence 2 with sentence 3. We ran the rewrite path with controlled direct refusals. The compiler keeps one attempt with two possible contents and requires the truck next to the hikers to be the truck that blocks the path. It refuses the version that gives the blocking action to the hikers.

New corpus pass

Some people crouch or sit on the ground for stability.

The same people appear in both actions and in the shared purpose. The program keeps the purpose outside the action alternatives.

Remaining attachment problem

Pedestrians are struggling to walk or stand in strong wind carrying a spray of water in Jiangmen.

The rewrite makes the wind the subject of “carrying.” The source dependency analysis attaches that predicate to walking, so it does not establish the link to wind. The compiler leaves this case unresolved.

These controls run the compiled programs with fixed evidence states. A complete utterance asserting one alternative refutes the full-content condition. An incomplete transcript leaves it unknown. The two-truck case checks that two separate candidates cannot jointly satisfy one shared condition.

Five failure-only rewrites

Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 received one fixed request per claim after SRL and AMR failed. The 14-second batch ran on one A100. The full job took 310 seconds with model loading. The sentences and formula below are the returned proposals.

Scope check refused the split

Only question is whether it will be a majority government or a minority government.
  1. The only question is whether the government will be a majority government.
  2. The only question is whether the government will be a minority government.

Proposed formula. (Sentence 1 OR Sentence 2)

Reading. The source poses one question with two possible answers. The rewrite presents two separate claims about which question is the only one.

Compiler message. Keep embedded, qualified or otherwise ambiguous alternatives in their source scope.

One sentence failed to compile

Shows picture of what the voter information service page looks like: can find electoral district, look at the map, profile, etc. with a place you can type your postal code and search ('Go') or a link you can click to find an electoral district without a postal code.
  1. The page shows a picture of what the voter information service page looks like.
  2. You can find an electoral district.
  3. You can look at the map.
  4. You can look at the profile.
  5. You can look at other details.
  6. There is a place where you can type your postal code and search.
  7. There is a 'Go' button to start the search.
  8. There is a link you can click to find an electoral district without a postal code.

Proposed formula. (Sentence 1 AND (Sentence 2 OR Sentence 3 OR Sentence 4 OR Sentence 5) AND (Sentence 6 AND Sentence 7) AND Sentence 8)

Reading. OR is placed over the page's list of features. The actual choice is between postal-code search and a link that works without a postal code. The rewrite joins those two methods with AND.

Compiler message. c6: Unrepresented source content: search

Scope check refused the split

The man in the blue blazer is presumably a lawyer or member of law enforcement.
  1. The man in the blue blazer is presumably a lawyer.
  2. The man in the blue blazer is presumably a member of law enforcement.

Proposed formula. (Sentence 1 OR Sentence 2)

Reading. Both occupations and the blue blazer survive. The original presumption governs one disjunction. The rewrite puts separate presumptions on its two claims.

Compiler message. Keep embedded, qualified or otherwise ambiguous alternatives in their source scope.

Invalid formula

Some people crouch or sit on the ground for stability.
  1. Some people crouch on the ground.
  2. Some people sit on the ground.
  3. Crouching or sitting on the ground provides stability for some people.

Proposed formula. ((Sentence 1 AND Sentence 3) OR (Sentence 2 AND Sentence 3))

Reading. The proposed formula uses sentence 3 twice. That sentence also changes the purpose “for stability” into a claim about what the actions provide.

Compiler message. Formula must use each sentence exactly once.

Scope check refused the split

Pedestrians are struggling to walk or stand in strong wind carrying a spray of water in Jiangmen.
  1. Pedestrians are struggling to walk in strong wind in Jiangmen.
  2. Pedestrians are struggling to stand in strong wind in Jiangmen.
  3. Strong wind in Jiangmen is carrying a spray of water.

Proposed formula. ((Sentence 1 OR Sentence 2) AND Sentence 3)

Reading. The walk and stand alternatives stay under struggling. The spray becomes a separate statement and the rewrite leaves the link from that wind to the pedestrians implicit.

Compiler message. This rewrite needs two parallel branches with one source coordinator.

Twelve evaluation claims

The authored readings were frozen before parsing. The first automatic pass selects the reviewed program. When both parsers fail, the case shows their reasons.

Partial · Reported speech

The guide said that the gate was open or the bridge was closed.

Reference reading. One report by the guide contains two alternatives. The gate was open, or the bridge was closed. Evidence of reporting only one of these as an assertion is insufficient to establish the disjunctive content.

Finding. AMR keeps the OR inside one report. The emitted evidence conditions allow one content branch to suffice if the enclosing report condition is already marked supported. The form needs a check that the utterance expressed the full alternative.

A hiker stood beside a red truck or a blue van.

Reference reading. One hiker stood beside a location candidate satisfying red truck or blue van. Red applies to the truck and blue applies to the van.

No program · Modifiers

A red vehicle, either a truck or a van, stopped at the gate.

Reference reading. One vehicle stopped at the gate. Its color is red and its type is truck or van. The color and stopping event apply to the same vehicle in either alternative.

Finding. SRL lacks an explicit alternative group for the type of vehicle. AMR puts “either” on the OR node and the converter refuses the annotation.

  • SRL. Nominal OR has no explicit alternative group.
  • AMR. An annotated coordination needs explicit scope.

No program · Modifiers

After noon, the runner either turned left or stopped.

Reference reading. Turning left or stopping after noon is sufficient. The person and after-noon constraint apply to both alternatives. Left modifies the turn only.

Finding. SRL takes “left” as an unsupported predicate. AMR puts the shared after-noon condition on the OR node and the converter refuses the annotation.

  • SRL. Predicate position is not a lexical/state predicate: left
  • AMR. An annotated coordination needs explicit scope.

No program · Exclusion

A hiker stood beside a red truck or a blue van, but not both.

Reference reading. For the same hiker and standing context, exactly one location description holds. Evidence for both refutes the exclusion.

Finding. SRL detects that its output drops the source negation. AMR leaves the contrast containing “not both” untranslated and refuses.

  • SRL. A source negation is absent from the logical operators. Preserve the intended negated clause.
  • AMR. Not all AMR nodes were visited.

No program · Exclusion

In a single flash, the lamp showed red or blue, but not both.

Reference reading. At one flash of the lamp exactly one of red and blue was displayed. Evidence of both colors in the same flash refutes the exclusion.

Finding. SRL catches missing negation. AMR rejects the relation from the contrast to the display event, leaving exclusion unspecified.

  • SRL. A source negation is absent from the logical operators. Preserve the intended negated clause.
  • AMR. No scope policy for contrast-01 :ARG1 show-01

Incorrect · Exclusion

Exactly one of the front and rear doors was open.

Reference reading. The claim concerns two doors at the same reference time. One is open and the other is not open.

Finding. SRL passes after treating “one” as a referent. It never represents two separate doors or the requirement that exactly one is open. The AMR quantity is also detached from a count of the two door states.

Exact logical form and program
EXISTS X1, X2: ((referent(X1, one, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND property(X1, advmod, Exactly, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND referent(X2, doors, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND property(X2, mod, front and rear, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND entity_relation(X1, of, X2, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND EXISTS E1: ((be(E1, ARG1, X1, ARG2, {"kind":"text","value":"open"}, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND EXISTS T0: (temporal(E1, past, simple, T0, unspecified, scope, world, route, unspecified))))))

Full match · Exclusion

Either the front door or the rear door was open.

Reference reading. This is an inclusive control. Evidence that either door was open suffices. Evidence that both were open also supports the claim.

Finding. SRL keeps two door descriptions and combines their open states with inclusive OR. Both doors can be open.

Exact logical form and program
EXISTS T0: ((EXISTS X1: ((referent(X1, door, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND property(X1, mod, front, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND EXISTS E1: ((be(E1, ARG1, X1, ARG2, {"kind":"text","value":"open"}, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND temporal(E1, past, simple, T0, unspecified, scope, world, route, unspecified))))) OR EXISTS X2: ((referent(X2, door, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND property(X2, mod, rear, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND EXISTS E2: ((be(E2, ARG1, X2, ARG2, {"kind":"text","value":"open"}, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND temporal(E2, past, simple, T0, unspecified, scope, world, route, unspecified)))))))

The pier or terminal area claim

The video takes place on a large, open paved pier or terminal area.

Previously the converter refused the AMR because the modifier edges pointed to pier. The repaired form keeps the two location descriptions separate.

  1. The video takes place on a large, open, paved pier.
  2. The video takes place on a terminal area.

The compiled OR accepts either branch. These two descriptions can both apply to one location.

Exact AMR, logical form and program
(b / be-located-at-91
      :ARG1 (v / video)
      :ARG2 (o / or
            :op1 (p / pier
                  :mod (l / large)
                  :ARG1-of (p2 / pave-01)
                  :ARG1-of (o2 / open-06))
            :op2 (a / area
                  :mod (t / terminal))))
EXISTS E1, X2, X3: ((concept(E1, be-located-at-91, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND concept(X2, video, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND role(E1, ARG1, X2, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND (EXISTS X5: ((concept(X3, pier, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND concept(X5, large, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND role(X3, mod, X5, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND EXISTS E6: ((concept(E6, pave-01, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND role(E6, ARG1, X3, scope, world, route, unspecified))) AND EXISTS X7: ((concept(X7, open-06, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND role(X7, ARG1, X3, scope, world, route, unspecified))))) OR EXISTS X9: ((concept(X3, area, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND concept(X9, terminal, scope, world, route, unspecified) AND role(X3, mod, X9, scope, world, route, unspecified)))) AND role(E1, ARG2, X3, scope, world, route, unspecified)))

Partial · clause scope

Provisional · TzzhcBIczf_M_2127

Shi Yongxin deviated from the identity of a monk in running the temple.

Reference reading. The way Shi Yongxin ran the temple diverged from his role as a monk.

Finding. The same actor is attached to running and deviating, but the temple-running clause has an unresolved complement instead of an explicit respect or manner relation.

Strict SRL · T3HTSBW42QaY_787

The crane lifts a large white container off of the boat and onto the pier at 12:12:57.

Reference reading. At 12:12:57 the crane lifts the same large white container from the boat onto the pier.

Finding. The source, destination, lifted entity and event time survive. The clock is also incorrectly attached as a property of the pier.

Binding contrasts with reviewed frame evidence

Each pair supplies the same candidate regions or objects, the same frame times, and the same words. Only the assignment changes. OCR refers to text read from the frame. The visual route handles displayed colors. Source groups and clip hashes are disjoint across the two splits.

We built and evaluated ten logic programs using the inspected assignments as input. All return the expected label under that control. The supplied identities and exact time points simplify grounding. Feature extraction and model evaluation remain later steps.

One English overlay claim could not serve as exact OCR supervision because the displayed text is Arabic. The robot contrast was also withheld because the numeric identity of the fallen robot could not be established. The earlier music labels need listening review.

These five pairs are reserved for benchmark development. See the feature and training design checklist.

How the changes work

Preserve would

The EU tariff rate would be 20%.

Before: Earlier AMR: an actual rate of twenty percent.

Current behavior: Current: an explicit would qualification encloses the rate and value. Its conditional, future-in-past or habitual reading is not guessed. A score for an actual rate alone cannot support this qualified statement.

Inspect the saved stages, conditions and errors.

Keep quoted text on its carrier

“Medicine faculty is back” and “Narco state” written in graffiti.

Before: Earlier AMR: faculty return and narcotic-state conditions become ordinary events/entities.

Current behavior: Current: one graffiti carrier has both exact strings as written-text conditions. Quoted propositions are not asserted as real events. Inverse-role modifiers and the conjunction stay inside the quotation being normalized.

Inspect the saved stages, conditions and errors.

Preserve shared participants after simplification

The camera broadcasting this livestream is owned by IPC.

Before: Both original parser paths fail their checks.

Current behavior: The single cached rewrite supplies two short clauses. Composition uses one camera variable for broadcasting and ownership and preserves IPC. The request is reached only after both original paths fail.

Inspect the saved stages, conditions and errors.

Keep depicted content after simplification

A clip shows a boat capsizing.

Before: The rewriter supplies “A clip shows a boat” and “The boat is capsizing.”

Current behavior: Composition keeps the same boat and puts capsizing inside the clip’s depiction context. It does not turn the second sentence into a separate world claim.

Inspect the saved stages, conditions and errors.

Refuse an unsupported generic interpretation

The closer to the surface an earthquake is, the greater the damage.

Before: An existential graph about one earthquake passes some earlier checks.

Current behavior: The shared check now flags the generic dependence. One observed earthquake is insufficient to establish the general relationship. General quantifier inference has not been implemented.

Inspect the saved stages, conditions and errors.

Keep implication distinct from AND

No containers in the water implies this was potentially recorded after cleanup already began.

Before: The cached split supplies two sentences that a flat AND could accept.

Current behavior: The source implication must have a corresponding condition context. The shared check rejects the unrepresented implication and preserves the full failure record.

Inspect the saved stages, conditions and errors.

The quotation rules use both source spans and a uniquely bound artifact; they do not treat all quotation marks as inscriptions. Main-clause would is preserved literally. Embedded ambiguous would still refuses. Explicit generic comparative and universal constructions are flagged rather than given invented quantifier semantics. These checks do not cover every generic construction.

Complement classes use the official PropBank frames: look.02 expresses seeming, blame.01 has a blamed-content role, call.03 expresses demand, tweet.02 is a written message and sound.02 is noise production. Source constructions license the call/tweet/sound sense corrections; frame numbers are not global aliases. Names and explicit person-role nouns now outrank unrelated common-person tokens when adding grammatical number, so “people” does not make Trump or the narrator plural.

What happens when every stage fails

All 198 remaining claims have complete stage records. Parsing abstention means no complete program passed the fixed checks: the evidence verifier is not called and its probability distribution is absent. Insufficient evidence means a program exists, but its media observations do not settle the claim. A parsing failure is never relabeled as insufficient evidence or refutation.

First-stop codes are software diagnostics, not a full linguistic taxonomy. Full records retain both original parser errors, rewrite output and component/alignment errors. Wrong participant roles, noun senses, comparisons, names/amounts and unrecognized scope can also pass the checks. In particular, a valid primary-parser output skips AMR even when its meaning is imperfect.

Paper evaluation and training policy

Every automatic test claim remains in the denominator. Report parsing coverage, fidelity on checked readings, verification performance and cost separately. Controlled relation training can use checked logical forms and generated binding edits with inspected text/media labels; this does not establish unrestricted end-to-end performance. The complete automatic test includes parsing failures. No empirical relation training is run here, and these results do not establish training readiness.

Proposed next steps and goals

  1. Repair participant bindings and noun readings in the detected failures. Goal: recover meaning rather than only more executable programs.
  2. Improve checks on incorrect primary-parser passes. Goal: catch errors that currently prevent a useful AMR fallback from running.
  3. Use checked logical forms for controlled binding experiments and retain the full automatic test set. Goal: separate relation-learning performance from parsing coverage without hiding failures. Empirical training remains deferred.

The parser supplies grammatical links and semantic roles: who did what to whom. The compiler keeps those parts and their scope—whether an event is shown, planned, investigated or discussed. It then writes predicates, small statements that evidence functions can score.

        Earlier retained development pool
        The earlier retained pool remains 1,981/2,375. It is preserved separately from the new automatic fallback and has not been fully re-reviewed.
        Numbered roles retain the source parser’s labels. Nested boxes show context; repeated IDs identify the same participant. A diagnostic candidate may exist even when a check requests review.
        Specific speech options and naturally difficult visual evidence
        The earlier speech score asks whether a speaker presents any alternatives. The new check takes the two claimed options and asks whether the speaker relates those options as stated. For example, replacing a mute button by pressing volume-down twice differs from replacing it by pressing power twice. The same check can take a directional replacement, a contrast, or a denial of a replacement as input.
        The previous 48 queries show whether the changes address known errors. The 38 new queries use 12 different recordings and include substitutions, wrong speakers, reversed preferences, and inserted negation. We annotated the options and relation from the claim before scoring. Speaker, time, and candidate spans are fixed. All methods use frozen models and the same support threshold of 0.5.
        We compare whole-claim entailment from DeBERTa, the earlier check for any alternatives, and that earlier method with two additional Qwen scores for the presence of each option. We also test a single Qwen score for the specific options and their relationship, with and without the whole-claim score. Every required condition must use the same report span. When a method uses several scores, the logic program treats them as independent observations and multiplies them within the span.

        Visual evidence from original frames
        We selected eight frames with distance, motion blur, or occlusion before scoring. Each has three or four distinct marked regions and two counting claims. The control asks for two objects in a category marked once. The frozen vision model scores the original crops. The best pair takes the highest product of two region scores. Exact inference computes the chance that at least one pair succeeds and shares a region’s score wherever that region appears. The third method treats pair successes as independent.

        Speech alternatives and overlapping visual assignments
        We froze 24 excerpts from 21 new AMI recordings before scoring. Twelve present alternatives without the word “or.” Twelve describe additions or have no choice. We also changed one option and queried a different speaker for each of the twelve valid reports. The labels come from our review of the transcripts.         Content matching uses a frozen DeBERTa entailment model. We compare the earlier wording rules, a DeBERTa entailment score for the presence of alternatives, and a Qwen3-VL text classification score that distinguishes alternatives from additions and unclear cases. In DeepProbLog, one candidate span must match the requested speaker and time. We multiply its content score by its alternatives score. Encoding them as separate observations assumes independence within the span. The models are frozen and we use their raw scores with the same 0.5 decision threshold.

        Competing visual and OCR assignments
        Each claim has two regions, two identities, and two values such as colors or printed dates. We reuse five reviewed frame pairs and test the observed assignment and its swap.         What explicit binding adds to speech verification
        We test 96 queries from 12 previously reserved AMI meetings. They cover valid reports and paraphrases, small content edits, wrong speakers, wrong times, and alternatives split across two utterances. Every method sees the same candidate transcripts with annotated speakers and timestamps. These cases test whether the specified person made the report in the specified context.
        Whole-claim DeBERTa reads the transcript block and its speaker and time labels in one input. The three DeepProbLog variants use the same per-utterance DeBERTa scores and vary which conditions must belong to one utterance. The simple filter uses the full condition, then takes the highest score. An alternative cue is an explicit “or” or wording such as “another option.” Every method uses 0.5 as its final support threshold.

        Speaker-turn windows and speech score calibration
        We selected one naturally spoken disjunction from each of 24 AMI meeting series outside the earlier studies. The same transcript supports an original report and a paraphrase.         Scoring with annotated transcripts
        Frozen DeBERTa predicts entailment, contradiction, or neither from the transcript and the reported content. We fit a two-parameter logistic function on the entailment score. A calibrated probability of 0.5 or higher gives support. The Brier score is the mean squared difference between the probability and the expected binary label. Lower is better.

The uncalibrated score ranks the faithful paraphrase above its edited version in 24 of 24 test pairs. Calibration preserves that ordering. On the initial wording, calibration raises accuracy from 37 to 41 of 48. We corrected five paraphrase or edit phrasings, including one grammatical error noticed after inspecting the test decisions. The download retains the initial wording and results.

        Logical-form benchmark review
        We sampled new claims after excluding earlier reviewed IDs and repeated text. The strict sample covers names, quantities, qualifiers, source scope and coordination, with six general cases. The provisional sample covers advisory checks and unresolved AMR structures. These judgments come from an assistant development review.

        A full match preserves the required participants, relations and qualifiers. A partial form retains the main reading with a missing or under-specified condition. An incorrect form materially changes the reading. Two claims need context to settle the intended reading. The selected sample supports error analysis. Corpus-wide accuracy and media support require separate evaluation.
        Numeric bindings and units account for eight primary issues. Participant bindings account for six, and missing qualification accounts for five. A qualification tells us how to read the proposition, for example as likely, reported or inferred.
        Advisory checks
        The checks look for missing name components or handles, numeric values with their units and range bounds, explicit alternatives and missing qualifiers. They flagged seven sampled programs. Inspection confirmed the named issue in each one, including six strict SRL passes. The rules were developed during this audit, so this comparison measures their behavior on development cases.
        The same rules flagged 106 of 2,358 saved programs for follow-up. Those flags are review leads. Program generation covers 2,358 of all 2,375 claims, with 17 dependency analyses. Warnings leave the compiler output and routing intact.
        Benchmark and feature design
        The reviewed logical forms and the five frame-based binding pairs are reserved for evaluation development. The binding pairs test whether the same video frames support different assignments of the same words. For a later feature comparison, use uniform frame sampling as a baseline, then compare keyframe selection for long clips and attention scores where the frozen model exposes them. Use time-local audio and speaker-aligned transcript spans for speech and sound. Keep the selected evidence fixed across both versions of each pair. Plan source-disjoint training data separately. These feature choices are proposals.

        What the extra programs preserve
        These development examples show where the changes recover a relationship and where a valid program still leaves the meaning incomplete. All selected forms retain their actual stage and source checks.
        An image of a tweet with a named author
        Shows image of the tweet from Trump: 'Good luck to the Great people of Canada. Elect the man who has the strength and wisdom to cut your taxes in half, increase your military power, for free, to the highest level in the World, have your Car, Steel, Aluminum, Lumber, Energy, and all other businesses, QUADRUPLE in size, WITH ZERO TARIFFS OR TAXES, if Canada becomes the cherished 51st. State of the United States of America. No more artificially drawn line from many years ago. Look how beautiful this land mass would be. Free access with NO BORDER. ALL POSITIVES WITH NO NEGATIVES. IT WAS MEANT TO BE! America can no longer subsidize Canada with the Hundreds of Billions of Dollars a year that we have been spending in the past. It makes no sense unless Canada is a State!'
        The program links the image depiction, exact tweet text and named author. The quote contains requests and hypothetical events, and the program keeps their wording inside the OCR condition.
        Inspect the saved form.
        A question about whether someone is missing
        Commenters ask if anyone is missing, it's unclear if there are.
        Both the question and the uncertainty refer to the AMR truth-value node. The new nested conditions preserve the question reading. The formula still needs a check of variable binding across the negated clarity clause before it can settle the claim.
        Inspect the saved form.
        One overlay, one exact quote
        Video overlay reading "Last year it took hours to get to the camp, now its only 25 mins" is visible.
        The same overlay is visible and carries the exact string. The old AMR treated the two travel times as events inside the graph. The new program asks for visual support for the overlay and OCR support for its text.
        Inspect the saved form.
        Negation over all votes
        Notes that not all lost NDP votes went to the Liberals.
        “Not all” narrows the claim to a quantified subset. The AMR graph gives a negated argument but leaves its projection unresolved, so the output contains grammatical links only.
        Inspect the saved form.
        Voting alternatives with a condition on one branch
        The speaker notes that Canadians may vote on election day, at advance polls, or by mail-in ballot if they are outside the country, with more information coming on the Elections Canada website.
        The source links being outside the country to the mail-in alternative. The AMR graph shares an alternative across contexts, and the compiler leaves its scope for review.
        Inspect the saved form.
        A shared local lead does not fix the vote-count meaning
        Riding-level result (Peterborough): Liberal candidate Emma Harrison is leading locally with 2740 votes reported, followed by Conservative Michelle Ferreri with 1932 (increasing) and NDP candidate Heather Ray with 137.
        The graph now keeps “locally” linked to the same leading event and preserves names and numbers. It also encodes the reported vote count through an AMR causal relation and leaves later counts underspecified.
        Inspect the saved form.
        Majority and minority remain alternatives within a question
        Only question is whether it will be a majority government or a minority government.
        The AMR polarity node now encloses the OR alternatives within question scope. The form still lacks a clear future qualification for “will.”
        Inspect the saved form.
        An otherwise clause needs context
        Otherwise, importers would need to get a refund.
        The graph contains an unlinked minus-valued argument. The preceding condition is implicit in “otherwise.” A dependency analysis keeps the surface attachments and does not infer an antecedent.
        Inspect the saved form.
        A long quote begins in the middle of a sentence
        Some on-screen text, cut off, says '...experienced one of the worst wildfire sieges in its history. When the fires finally ended on November 5, 1993, there were four fatalities, over 1,200 structures had been destroyed, nearly 200,000 acres had been swept by 22 different fires — and the response cost/damage estimate approached $1 billion'.
        The source says some on-screen text is cut off. The new program keeps that property and the literal quote together. The casualties, dates and other details stay inside the written text.
        Inspect the saved form.
        The four establishments share a location
        It is implied that Rosenthal Winery, Wiley's Bakeshop, Cholada Thai, and the Topanga Ranch Motel are all establishments near Topanga Beach.
        The selected program keeps the content beneath “imply” and retains four names and the location. The location is attached to a generic establishments description, so a check should connect it to each listed member under a shared implied context.
        Inspect the saved form.
        An implication has content and an owner
        The allegations imply that Shi Yongxin's position as Abbot was obtained illegitimately.
        The allegations own the implied clause. Shi Yongxin is linked to the Abbot position, and the illegitimate obtaining stays inside that clause.
        Inspect the saved form.
        Earlier SRL can compile a phrase while losing its OR
        The video takes place on a large, open paved pier or terminal area.
        The earlier converter produces a program but treats pier and terminal area as members of a group. The source allows either place. The program also analyzes the idiom “takes place” as a literal take predicate.
        Inspect the saved form.
        Crouching or sitting shares a purpose
        Some people crouch or sit on the ground for stability.
        The two actions remain alternatives using one people variable. The purpose condition applies to the coordination as a whole, and the ground condition stays attached to sitting. The generated scope still requires a compatible evidence function.
        Inspect the saved form.
        Depiction of a reporter wearing a raincoat
        A reporter in Zhuhai, Guangdong is shown wearing a white raincoat.
        The program links the same wearer and white raincoat to the depiction in Zhuhai, Guangdong. AMR also represents the reporter through a reporting event. The source gives a profession and does not require a reporting event in the clip.

        Table 191. General changes and their limits. ARG numbers are frame-specific AMR roles; ARG0 does not always mean agent.
        Source constructionImplemented interpretationLimit
        “Qian Dan” refers to the expulsion …The term names a definition. The expulsion and related vows stay inside its definition context.Does not assert a real expulsion.
        A lunar landing missionThe landing describes the mission purpose.The parser still wrongly types this named mission as an organization.
        Request that trams intersectThe requested content stays in request context.Location attachment in the motivating example is still imperfect.
        Manufacturing tools to build a spacecraftTool function and build purpose receive separate purpose contexts.Not every infinitive indicates purpose; source attachment and governing verb are required.
        A pneumatic drill / a surprising rulingA lexicalized tool compound and explicit nominal links support object/result readings.Polysemous event nouns and unresolved roles still require review.
        The first responderKeep a person with a role description on the same referent.No timed response is inferred just from the role noun.
        Scope records whether content is asserted directly, requested, defined or intended. A request is not its fulfillment. Normalization changes a graph using explicit source links, while retaining a trace of the old and new triples. Nominal “of” and “to” links are source-normalized relations, not claims of standard gold AMR annotation. The AMR guidelines already cover predicate nouns and participant readings; several defects here were in our conversion, not a general inability of AMR to represent nouns. Neither grammar nor WordNet can establish factuality.

        How the changes work
        Table 197. Implemented changes and their limits.
        ChangeWhat it doesLimit
        Predicate typesAn aligned adjective can be a property; an event expressed as a noun can be a nominal event. AMR degree/rate structures are relationships, not ordinary clauses.Part of speech does not resolve event/object/result senses.
        Nominal alignmentWordNet derivational links connect event senses such as shaking/flight to shake/fly when one source anchor is available.Artifact/person noun senses are excluded from derivational matching; exact noun matches can still have the wrong sense.
        Audio and purposeSound content receives audio_event scope. A purpose relation keeps its goal inside a purpose context. Existing outer event nouns can be referenced inside that context.References cannot escape belief into the outer claim or cross unrelated contexts. More non-factual noun contexts remain unsupported.
        AliasesA small, explicit identity list accepts SCOTUS/full court name and US/USA/full country names, with compatible entity types.No fuzzy-name repair or general entity linker. Phillies/Phillipines stays rejected.
        UnitsA per-second/per-hour denominator of one is licensed only with a linked matching numerator and unit. Multiple one-second units may represent unspecified plural seconds.No guessed exact duration, rate range repair, or general unit conversion.
        A predicate describes an event, property or relationship. A nominal event is an event expressed by a noun, such as shaking. Scope records how content is presented: a goal is not its achievement, and sound evidence does not require visual evidence. ARG numbers depend on the AMR frame; ARG0 is not always an agent. The AMR specification explicitly uses predicates for nouns and adjectives. These are standard distinctions, not new paper terminology.

        Proposed next steps and goals
        1. Keep definitions, missions and requests in the correct context. Goal: prevent an event noun from becoming an assertion that the event actually occurred.
        2. Distinguish event nouns from objects and results. Goal: handle a drill as a tool and a ruling as a decision when that is the source meaning.
        3. Evaluate one compiler on new-source references. Goal: measure faithful compilation and false passes before adding more retries or starting relation training.

        The inference improvement
        DeepProbLog turns the program into a Boolean circuit before computing probabilities. Its default variable order separated outcomes belonging to the same observation. Keeping those outcomes together solves the refined 19-condition wind example in about 0.04 seconds, compared with a 12-second process limit under the original order. The program, probabilities and shared observations are unchanged. Two-candidate examples, 64-condition conjunctions and neural gradients also pass. This is a standard variable-ordering improvement to our implementation, not a new paper contribution.

        Correct the AMR using the original claim and dependency links. Preserve every claim detail, shared referent, negation, modality, source and time; copy names, quoted words and values exactly.
Return JSON with top and at most 8 triple edits. Replace/remove use original zero-based triple indices; add supplies a triple. Triples use PENMAN strings, including quotes on literal strings. New node IDs may be x1 through x8. Keep the graph connected.
Example: {"top":"s","edits":[{"op":"replace","index":2,"triple":["s",":ARG1","p"]}]}
Do not drop content merely to pass the compiler. If faithful correction is not possible, return the unchanged top and an empty edits list. Return JSON only.

The adapter validates roles, node declarations and connectivity, then recompiles. Source alignments and scope-head checks always refer back to the initial graph, so repeated retries cannot gradually erase a detail. These guards do not guarantee faithful semantics. Compiler feedback supplies the latest concrete errors; the generic control supplies a generic failure instruction. Both retain original errors and use the same retry budget.

Nominal shaking/flight need better lexical alignment; goals and questions need scope.         Concrete repairs and limits
        • Exact written text: a visible overlay now checks the original string “news 76”; a protest sign keeps its whole quotation without asserting the quoted events as world facts. A more complex overlay still refuses because its artifact is missing from the neural graph.
        • Time: “12:00am” becomes midnight00:00, tied to the correct date. Elapsed notation such as “T+57:24” stays elapsed, without guessing field units. An extra time fragment remains in one follow-up graph and is labelled partial.
        • Coordination and scope: coordinated participants get explicit group membership or OR alternatives. A report about rain has topic scope; urging people to stop remains a directive, not an actual stopping event. Quantifier and collective/distributive meanings are still incomplete.
        • Remaining binding errors: velocity at the end of a video becomes an ending-velocity event; “eyes closed” becomes a closing action; people depicted in video become people located at a video. Logic syntax and value matching do not fix these readings.

        Implemented design
        Table 210. What the source stage does. These operations do not certify semantic equivalence.
        OperationImplemented behaviourRemaining limit
        Word alignmentExact lemma/word matches, a small pronoun/person alias list and source-attached phrasal particles.No general word-sense, coreference or noun-compound disambiguation.
        Written quotationBind exact source string to a unique written artifact; remove only its owned semantic parse. Keep scope and external references.Only declared artifact constructions. Human reading and ordinary speech are not coerced to OCR.
        Names and amountsFlag changed/omitted names, unlicensed numbers and broken amount/unit pairs.These checks can flag legitimate paraphrases and miss wrong argument attachments.
        ClocksNormalise uniquely aligned am/pm; preserve elapsed notation and timezone labels.No guessed timezone or elapsed field units; ambiguous matches remain flagged.
        Linguistic numberAttach source plurality to an entity inside its existing scope.No general generic, count/mass or universal-quantifier solver. Event/unit plurality is metadata, not participant plurality.
        Group: an AND participant has explicit member conditions and is bound to one parent role. This does not force each member to perform a separate event; collective versus distributed participation needs an explicit relationship function. Alternative: OR participants share a chosen-candidate variable across their alternative descriptions. A name such as Alice remains required in every relevant branch; it cannot disappear after the first visit. Unsupported external re-entry or annotated coordination still refuses.
        Complement scope: shared classes distinguish assertion, topic, prediction, directive, accusation, requirement, cancellation, attempt, completion and other declared cases. Every inner condition receives the complete owner/context chain. For instance, urge → stop → activity remains nested under directive and cessation. A class label is a contract for the future evidence function; it is not a learned verifier or a full treatment of factivity, projection and quantification. Official PropBank role definitions inform the inventory; unknown cases still refuse.

        OperatorSupportedRefutedUnknown
        ANDAll children supportedAt least one child refutedOtherwise
        ORAt least one child supportedAll children refutedOtherwise
        NOTChild refutedChild supportedChild unknown

Leaf observations still have all three mutually exclusive outcomes, including neural outcomes whose current probability is zero. Shared observation IDs stay shared. Tests compare exact world enumeration, shared-variable AND/OR, constants, NOT and PyTorch gradients against the earlier exact encoding. This changes Boolean rules, not probability values or their interpretation.

        How the converter works
        Compositional means that each concept, relationship or logical operator contributes a corresponding condition. For example, document ARG1-of sign becomes sign ARG1 document. Relation direction is normalised before composition. A negated predicate keeps all its own roles under NOT, rather than leaving a positive argument link outside it.
        Table 216. Existing backend contracts used by the new frontend. No media implementation or learned score is supplied by this conversion.
        ConditionMeaning
        concept(candidate, concept, …)A frozen perception function would check the concept on this candidate.
        role(source, role, target, …)A fixed or learned relationship function would check this explicit binding.
        name / quantity / temporalMatching functions must check names, amounts or source-aligned time conditions.
        proposition(owner, role, kind, context, …)The body belongs to this owner and context, such as assertion, depiction, purpose or appearance.
        A context specifies how a subclaim is presented. world is the outer claim; it is not a certificate of world truth. Conditions inside an assertion/purpose context are not automatically facts outside it. Their inputs include the complete chain of owning source/event variables, so changing the source assignment changes the evidence being checked. An unspecified assertion remains unspecified; it does not automatically imply audible speech.
        Every semantic graph condition has a translation record; wiki links are explicitly metadata. Clause AND/OR is supported. Participant coordination needs a group or alternative-binding interpretation and currently refuses. A source noun can carry an AMR predicate sense, so a sense suffix alone does not establish a clause-valued complement. Tense/aspect is added only at unique source-lemma alignments; this does not restore all source information.
        Two excluded development versions exposed missing context-owner inputs and inverse-role/negation defects. Both snapshots remain in the source bundle. Final tests cover those defects, shared actors/names, declaration order, graph operators, source routes and tense, plus native DeepProbLog returning unknown without observations. This is a restricted converter, not a complete AMR scope/projection system. Bos (2016), Lai et al. (2020) and the AMR specification explain the broader problem.
        Preparation for a small confidence model
        There are 22 saved development pairs: 13 reference matches and nine clear incorrect outputs. Inputs contain the sentence and compiled conditions/formula; labels remain outside inputs. Partial and context-dependent cases are excluded. No confidence model was trained or calibrated. One cached candidate per sentence cannot test ranking over alternatives. A future sentence/graph encoder would be separate from the paper’s media-conditioned binding classifiers.

        What changed in the implementation
        • Subtree replacement: the model can replace an existing logical subtree, including a wrong root, while keeping the existing entity declarations. At most four typed edits are allowed.
        • Separate literal types: ordinary text cannot carry measurement-only fields such as unit, attribute or numeric range. Arguments use standard PropBank/UD roles.
        • Joint participant checks: a missing subject in an infinitival purpose is checked using agreement between source SRL and dependencies. A dependency-only subject is advisory, so an incorrect parse need not become a mandatory semantic edge.
        • Fairer retry input: both new branches receive the original error on every attempt. Only the feedback branch additionally receives diagnostics for the latest candidate.
        Correction to the earlier typed-edit description: the saved generic retry messages did not explicitly retain the original compiler error. The earlier numerical results remain unchanged; the new comparison fixes that input difference. Both conditions and all original messages remain inspectable.
